description: Source code implementing JSON-based template rendering functions using the Mustach templating engine, including functions for file, memory, and callback-based rendering, as well as internal JSON object traversal and comparison logic.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the exploration context for JSON traversal.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares a JSON object selection with a string value, handling different JSON types.

methods.name: sel
methods.description: Selects a JSON object or array element by name or index.

methods.name: subsel
methods.description: Sub-selects an element within a JSON object or array.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Enters a JSON object or array for iteration, managing depth and iterator state.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next element in a JSON object or array during iteration.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Leaves the current JSON object or array context, decreasing depth.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value as a string for template rendering.
